steps.patterns: A chord doesn’t have to be played all at once. Block chords press all the notes together; broken chords play them one after another; the Alberti bass, named after Domenico Alberti, goes lowest, highest, middle, highest: {c} {g} {e} {g}.
steps.block: Block chords: four beats on each of I, IV and V, then I.
steps.broken: Broken chords: the same chords, one note at a time, up and back to the middle.
steps.alberti: The Alberti bass: lowest, highest, middle, highest, twice per bar.
steps.melodyOverAlberti: Put a slow melody on top: the right hand holds long notes while the left hand keeps the Alberti bass moving.
